title: Grateful Dead Live at Carousel Ballroom on 1968-03-31
lineage: AUD > MR > D > PCM > D > CD > EAC > SHN

ai_review.summary: Clear soundboard capture of a beautiful, fresh take on “Feedback” from the final Anthem‑of‑the‑Sun show.
ai_review.review: The recording is praised for its unusually pristine clarity – almost too clean for an audience source – indicating a high‑quality soundboard feed. Musically the fragment shines with a standout performance of “Feedback,” captured at what many consider the last concert of the Anthem of the Sun studio sessions, and ends with the haunting “Bid You Good Night.” Overall reviewers find it a very good, if not legendary, piece of the Dead’s 1968 output.

ai_rating.rationale: Consistently positive 4‑star reviews note excellent sound clarity and a strong performance of “Feedback”; recording quality is described as exceptional, giving the combined weighted score a solid 4.3.

recording_quality.technical_notes: Audio is described as ‘way too clear’ for an audience tape, suggesting a very clean soundboard mix with no noticeable drop‑outs or muddiness.

show_quality.setlist_flow: Fragment of the last Anthem of the Sun concert (3/31/68), focusing on a fresh “Feedback” segment and concluding with “Bid You Good Night.”
